title: Personal Checking Schedule of Service Charges
content:
The charges below are the amounts each Personal Checking tier takes for wires, stop payment orders, official checks, replacement debit cards and account research.

| Tier | Outgoing domestic wire (USD) | Outgoing international wire (USD) | Incoming wire credited to the account (USD) | Official check purchased from the account (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 30.00 | 50.00 | 15.00 | 10.00 |
| Student Checking | 30.00 | 50.00 | 15.00 | 10.00 |
| Everyday Checking | 30.00 | 50.00 | 15.00 | 10.00 |
| Interest Checking | 30.00 | 50.00 | 15.00 | 10.00 |
| Premier Checking | 20.00 | 40.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Private Client Checking | 10.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

| Tier | Stop payment order or renewal (USD) | Stop payment orders and renewals free of charge per statement cycle | Standard-delivery replacement debit card (USD) | Rush delivery of a replacement debit card, in addition (USD) | Account research per hour (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 32.00 | 0 | 5.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| Student Checking | 32.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| Everyday Checking | 32.00 | 0 | 5.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| Interest Checking | 32.00 | 1 | 5.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| Premier Checking | 32.00 | 2 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 25.00 |
| Private Client Checking | 32.00 | 5 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

A charge of 0.00 means no charge row is written on that tier. The free stop payment allowance is counted per statement cycle and covers renewals as well as first orders.

**Points of judgement.** The stop payment charge itself is 32.00 on every tier; what differs is how many orders and renewals a tier gives free in the cycle, from none on Access Checking, Student Checking and Everyday Checking to 5 on Private Client Checking. The rush charge is additional to the standard charge rather than in place of it.
